Product Designer (Mid-level)

The role
Join a small design team shaping a scheduling app used by 40,000 clinics. You'll own features end to end, from research to polished UI.

What you'll be doing
- Run user research and usability sessions with clinic staff
- Create wireframes, prototypes and high-fidelity designs in Figma
- Contribute to and maintain our design system
- Work closely with engineers to ship accessible, responsive interfaces

What we're looking for
- 3+ years of product design experience
- Expert in Figma
- A portfolio showing UX design and UI design work
- Experience with design systems and accessibility standards
- Excellent communication skills

Bonus points
- HTML and CSS
- Framer for motion prototypes
